name: Sacramento County, CA
findings: Sacramento County has 5,235 nonprofit organizations. 2,375 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,997 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sacramento County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 138 political organizations here list membership, compared with about 41 in similar places of this size.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Sacramento County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 140 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 446 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
